candidats.description: St Lamberti Church in Münster , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany St. Lamberti is a Roman Catholic parish church in Münster’s old town . It was built between 1375 and 1525 as a market and civic church and is located on Lambertikirchplatz and at the corner of Salzstraße and Prinzipalmarkt . St. Lamberti is the most important sacred building of the Westphalian late Gothic period. It is named after St. Lambert of Liège.
